Method of Attack: Uses steganography to hide malware within image files
Downloads an image from Imgur, processes it with the judyb package to extract obfuscated Python code, and executes a malicious binary from a remote server
Impacted Systems: PyPI users through open-source projects on GitHub

Method of Attack: Steganography module used to hide and reveal hidden messages inside pictures
Extracts obfuscated Python code hidden in images, which retrieves and executes a malicious binary from a remote server
Impacted Systems: PyPI users through open-source projects on GitHub
